implementation_decisions.pretrained_weights: torchvision ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 (plain-CE ImageNet recipe); not V2, whose recipe (label smoothing, mixup, cutmix, EMA) reshapes confidence
implementation_decisions.head: fc replaced by Linear(2048, n_classes), PyTorch default init under the run seed; no dropout, no extra layer (penultimate = 2048-d avgpool, §5.2)
implementation_decisions.frozen_layers: none — full fine-tuning; BatchNorm in train mode on train folds, eval mode on val
implementation_decisions.loss: nn.CrossEntropyLoss(), mean over batch; no class weight, no label smoothing
implementation_decisions.optimizer_details: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8; one param group, weight decay on all parameters incl. BatchNorm and bias
implementation_decisions.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=40 epochs, eta_min=0), stepped once per epoch; no warmup, no restarts; schedule spans max epochs regardless of early stopping
implementation_decisions.amp: CUDA only: autocast float16 + GradScaler (init scale 2**16); losses computed in float32; val forward also under autocast
implementation_decisions.early_stopping: monitor = CE summed over every val patch / n (sample-weighted), eval mode, no augmentation; improvement iff strictly below best (min_delta 0) so ties keep the earlier epoch; NaN/inf never improves; stop after 8 non-improving epochs; restore best-epoch weights; val accuracy logged, never used for selection
implementation_decisions.checkpoint: best epoch only (no 'last'); torch.save dict of fp32 CPU state_dict + metadata; atomic write (tmp + rename); JSON sidecar; no optimizer state
implementation_decisions.resume: none: a crashed run restarts from scratch with the same seed and stays the same slot; attempts logged; a finished slot refuses to rerun
implementation_decisions.seeds: slots 1-5: 42; ensemble members 2-5 (slots 6-9): 43-46; ablations (slots 10-11): 42, paired with slot 1; one seed drives python/numpy/torch RNG and the loader generators
implementation_decisions.determinism: cudnn.deterministic=True, cudnn.benchmark=False, use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; bitwise GPU reproducibility not guaranteed (some CUDA backward kernels)
implementation_decisions.device: real runs refuse to start without CUDA; no channels_last, no torch.compile, no EMA/SWA
